audit.note: zip=build-dep of libduckdb-sys; rkyv=unenabled rust_decimal feature; quinn*=non-runtime edge

preconditions: TMPDIR must be on a FUSE-permitted path: ambient TMPDIR=/var/tmp/hermes-scratch gives 'fusermount3: mount failed: Permission denied' / 'Operation not permitted (os error 1)' and dfwarpfs30_trigger_mount_lock fails at its 30s deadline; same binary mounts in ~500ms under a HOME path

$HOME must not carry a root-level stale graph cache: /home/kara/.vfs/graph/graph.db (1,847,296 B, 2026-09-11, pre-granularity schema) was adopted by every hilo invocation whose workspace is under /home/kara, producing 'Referenced column "granularity" not found' and a graph_stats that reported the /home/kara tree; quarantined by rename to /home/kara/.vfs.quarantine-20261113 (reversible, no live consumer, no references in ~/.hermes/scripts)

release.defect_found: published .sha256 line embeds the builder absolute path (/home/kara/.hermes/cache/scratch/warpfs-releng-2026-11-12-16-02-23/assets-v0.4.1/...), so sha256sum -c only works on the build host and silently validated a stale local copy here; emit a bare filename

why_not_complete: boardctl update --status complete REQUIRES --evidence-run-id bound to a .gitreins/history/<date>/<run>/ directory (TR-251); this ops fire produced no judge run, so the row stays pending with all four arms measured PASS
